summary: 1931 log-crib lookout replaced in 1961 by an R-6 flat-top cab near Warren, Idaho; drive-up Forest Service site, generally staffed in fire season.

facts.design: R-6 flat-top cab on a ten-foot concrete block base (1961 replacement); original was an L-4 cab on a log crib (1931)

access.note: Drive-up Forest Service lookout, generally staffed during fire season. No source describes public climbing or rental.

facts.agency: US Forest Service - Payette National Forest

events.note: First tower: ten-foot log crib with an L-4 cab, per Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts.
Salt Lake Tribune item (reprinted on Rex's Fire Lookout Page) names a retired banker and his wife at War Eagle assisting with fire work.
Newspaper item places a blaze near War Eagle Lookout, ten miles from Warren.
Original structure replaced by a Region 6 flat-top cab on a ten-foot concrete block base.
Idaho Fire Lookouts known-staff list begins with Judy Puderbaugh, 1971 (list continues to 2012).
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register on November 29, 2020.

corrections.why: Two sources record the original log crib lookout in 1931; the 1961 date belongs to the replacement cab and base, which the NHLR page also gives as the build year.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 1961 as the build year, while Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 1931 for the first structure. Both are reported in the story; the 1961 date is the replacement tower.
Firelookout.com says staffed in summer; NHLR says generally staffed during the fire season. Reported as a difference, not resolved.

notes_for_editor: Build year conflicts (1931 first tower vs NHLR 1961) and the staffing schedule differ across sources. A WebSearch snippet mentions a 2000 Burgdorf Junction Fire spotting role and fire-wrapping; not verified on a fetched page, so left out. Current record height_m 3.0 is the ten-foot block base, not total height. Access left restricted; no source documents public climbing or rental.
